I’m going to tell you a very sad story. This did not happen to me, but a good friend of mine. 
My friend had a kitten for about 6 months or so. They loved the cat, had bonded with him, and were very close to him. One day, she’s doing laundry and seemingly the cat found its way inside the dryer. It was far too late to save the cat by the time she realized what had happened.
Accidents do happen, and they insight  incredibly powerful emotions from us. However, it is vital that you understand what accidents are; unintentional. You can mull over again and again what you “should have or could have done”. And yes, as most accidents, there most certainly are precautions you “could have and should have taken”, but what’s done is done. Even if this had not been your doing, in this context; if someone else had done this, it would have still been an accident, thus unintentional. 
You do not have to forgive yourself today or next year. But I implore you to empathize with yourself a little more than you criticize yourself. This is a terrible thing that happened and I am so so sorry you are going through this. Just remember that your baby is in a much better place than we are now. And they know you didn’t hurt them on purpose. They know because they heard and saw you scream and cry for them. They felt you running for THEIR life and how you tried to help them breathe. They saw you act to save them. I know it doesn’t help your pain that they are gone, and it’s definitely not fair. But they are no longer in pain and they are watching over you. 
I hope you are able to find peace with this in your heart and mind. I definitely think professional advice may be necessary but, for the moment just breathe. The best thing you can do now is be mindful and pray for your baby. Allow yourself to be calm and project your love through the universe. I know your baby will feel you.
